name: Bubble Pop
hook: Pop bubbles, drop clusters, flood your rivals.
how: Aim the launcher and shoot: 3 of a color pop, and anything left hanging falls. Drop 3 or more and a rival gets an extra row pushed in from the top. A bubble past the line is out; last board standing wins.
controls: Mouse to aim, click to shoot, right-click or Shift to swap; on touch, drag to aim and let go
uses: Every rival's board, aim and shots play out next to yours.
The host's browser runs the match: who is out, the winner and the restart. If it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill empty seats: they line up shots and go for big drops.
Each player's best score in one match.
ideas: Add a bomb bubble that pops everything around it
